clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Engages Global Leaders At APEC Summit
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto engaged in bilateral discussions with President Vladimir Putin while attending the APEC Summit in Shenzhen.
The summit featured high-level meetings between leaders including Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin, addressing trade and security issues.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Parliament Enacts Asset Seizure Law For Crime Victims
aiSummaryBullets: The new law allows the seizure of assets derived from corruption, online gambling, and other criminal offenses to compensate victims.
Legislators clarified that the statute does not include provisions for illicit enrichment regarding unexplained wealth.

clusters.headline: Bareskrim Polri Set to Hold Joint Case Review on Treason Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri is scheduled to conduct a joint case review regarding treason allegations with the Attorney General's Office.
Authorities have reportedly uncovered new evidence and facts following investigations and site searches at multiple locations.

clusters.headline: Residual Gas Suspected In Deadly Explosion At Cepu Oil Refinery
aiSummaryBullets: A fatal explosion occurred during cleaning operations at the PPSDM Migas Cepu oil and gas refinery in Blora, Central Java.
Police preliminary investigations suggest that the blast was triggered by gas trapped inside an empty tank.

clusters.headline: Puan Maharani Addresses Speculation Over New Vice President Pick
aiSummaryBullets: House Speaker Puan Maharani stated that PDIP will not propose a candidate for the vice president position.
Sufmi Dasco Ahmad is among the names frequently linked to the vacancy following the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

clusters.headline: Environment Minister Proposes Removing Ujung Kulon Mining Zones
aiSummaryBullets: Environment Minister Jumhur Hidayat requested the exclusion of Ujung Kulon waters from mining exploration areas to protect Javan rhinos.
House of Representatives Commission IV chair Siti Hediati Hariyadi opposed the proposed relocation of rhinos from Ujung Kulon to Alas Purwo.

clusters.headline: Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin Meets With DPR Deputy Speaker
aiSummaryBullets: Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin arrived at the parliamentary complex in Senayan, Jakarta, for a surprise visit.
The minister held a closed-door meeting with the Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives, Sufmi Dasco Ahmad.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Promotes Fair Partnerships During China Visit
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially stated Indonesia's support for transparent and equitable international cooperation.
The administration recently oversaw the signing of four strategic agreements with China valued at over Rp 1,300 trillion.

clusters.headline: KPK Re-examines BNPB Chief Secretary Over Disaster Fund Corruption
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) summoned BNPB Chief Secretary Rustian for further questioning as a witness.
Investigators are probing suspected corruption involving disaster readiness funds used for procurement of goods and services.

clusters.headline: Regional Governments In Indonesia Intensify Disaster Preparedness
aiSummaryBullets: Provincial and city governments are implementing infrastructure upgrades, including new pump houses and river normalization to mitigate flood risks.
Regional authorities are focusing on cross-sector coordination and increased emergency personnel to improve response times during the rainy season.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Reports State Budget Deficit Of Rp379 Trillion By October
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia's state budget deficit reached Rp379.3 trillion by October 2026, equivalent to 1.47 percent of the national GDP.
Finance officials maintain that a budget deficit does not equate to a financial loss, emphasizing the role of the APBN in national development.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Expands Illegal Parking Enforcement Across City Regions
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities are conducting regular monitoring of illegal parking hotspots including the Blok M, Gandaria City, and Rasuna Said areas.
Enforcement efforts involve the removal of illegally parked vehicles and the detention of unauthorized parking attendants.

clusters.headline: University Of Indonesia Dental Student Dies At Depok Apartment
aiSummaryBullets: A student identified by the initials AR died after falling from the 12th floor of an apartment building in the Beji district of Depok.
The deceased was enrolled in the Faculty of Dentistry at the University of Indonesia.

clusters.headline: BMKG Issues Heavy Rainfall Warnings As Indonesia Enters Peak Season
aiSummaryBullets: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) has confirmed that Indonesia has officially entered the peak of the 2026 rainy season.
Forecasts indicate widespread rainfall across the country, with specific alerts issued for heavy storms and lightning in multiple major cities.

clusters.headline: Jokowi Responds to Calls Supporting Sufmi Dasco for Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: President Jokowi stated he has provided no directives regarding the vice presidency, emphasizing his continued support for President Prabowo Subianto.
Various groups, including political figures and organizations like PP Perti, have publicly endorsed Sufmi Dasco Ahmad for the vice presidential role.

clusters.headline: Bank Indonesia Raises Benchmark Interest Rate To Six Percent Level
aiSummaryBullets: Bank Indonesia increased its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 6 percent during the November 2026 Board of Governors Meeting.
The central bank intends to incorporate state-owned lenders into its renminbi clearing operations starting in 2027.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Review Legal Framework For Regional Bonds
aiSummaryBullets: Legislators are debating the Regional Bond Bill to provide alternative financing for local governments.
Proponents suggest the scheme could mobilize significant capital, potentially reaching trillions of rupiah for infrastructure.

clusters.headline: Bareskrim Investigates Former Police Chief In Treason Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri has questioned former national police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo and three other generals in a treason investigation.
The inquiry is centered on allegations of illicit surveillance conducted by the former police leadership against President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: KPK Investigates ATR/BPN Officials Regarding HGB And HGU Corruption
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission is investigating the roles of three senior officials and two director generals within the Ministry of ATR/BPN.
The inquiry centers on the issuance of Building Rights Titles (HGB) and Cultivation Rights Titles (HGU) linked to bribery allegations.

clusters.headline: Corruption Probes And Enforcement Actions Target Customs Officials
aiSummaryBullets: Anti-corruption authorities are investigating financial transactions and health claims linked to customs officials accused of bribery.
A former customs director has received a nine-year prison sentence following a legal proceeding related to import-related graft.
